title: Balochistan Confinement of State Prisoners Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Confinement of State Prisoners Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
CONFINEMENT OF STATE
PRISONERS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Confinement of State
Prisoners Regulation, 1818
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated , 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the
Government of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Confinement of State Prisoners (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

sections.description:

ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLIII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
CONFINEMENT OF STATE
PRISONERS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Confinement of State
Prisoners Regulation, 1818
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated , 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the
Government of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Regulation III of 1818.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Confinement
of State Prisoners Regulation, 1818, hereinafter referred to as the said
Regulation, in section 4, for the words "Zila Magistrate" the words
"Sessions Judge" shall be substituted.
